Independent recognizer test fixtures (test-only; never embedded in the game).
Regenerate: node tools/kanjivg/fetch.mjs --fixtures && node tools/kanjivg/fixtures.mjs

animcjk-kana.json
  Source:    AnimCJK, svgsJaKana/<decimal code point>.svg,
             https://github.com/parsimonhi/animCJK (commit ec5e17cca76c87587790bcbce5ea0b4d4fb753d6)
  Copyright: AnimCJK 2016-2026 Copyright FM&SH
  Licence:   GNU Lesser General Public License v3 or later (the kana SVGs are
             not derived from Arphic fonts; see the project's licenses/COPYING.txt).
             https://www.gnu.org/licenses/lgpl-3.0.txt
  Changes:   only the stroke median polylines were extracted (for strokes that
             AnimCJK splits into clip parts a/b/c, part "a", which carries the
             whole median), coordinates rounded to integers in the 1024 box.

tomoe-ja.json
  Source:    Tomoe 0.6.0, data/handwriting-ja.xml,
             https://downloads.sourceforge.net/project/tomoe/tomoe/tomoe-0.6.0/tomoe-0.6.0.tar.gz
  Copyright: the Tomoe project (Kouhei Sutou, Hiroyuki Ikezoe, Takuro Ashie,
             Hiroyuki Komatsu and contributors)
  Licence:   GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1,
             https://www.gnu.org/licenses/old-licenses/lgpl-2.1.txt
  Changes:   only entries for characters the recognizer supports were kept
             (the kana, incl. two そ and two ね forms, and every kanji the game
             displays that Tomoe has: 1,633 entries for 1,601 characters);
             points unchanged (1000 box).

tomoe-unknown.json
  Source, copyright, licence: as tomoe-ja.json (Tomoe 0.6.0, LGPL v2.1).
  Changes:   300 entries for kanji the game does NOT use (every n-th such
             entry in file order), for measuring what the recognizer does with
             a kanji outside its set; points unchanged (1000 box).
